description: Local image bank for The Visitor. The app reads this on startup and uses listed files instead of calling generation APIs. Empty arrays = bank inactive, falls back to API → upload.
notes: After dropping new images into banks/<kind>/<slug>/ — list their filenames in the matching array above.
The Visitor picks one filename uniformly at random per use.
If an array is empty for the active mood/archetype, the app falls back to generation API → uploaded image.
See README.md for prompts to generate the images with.
